title: Elf Bar Plus 12 Prefilled Pod Vape Kits
description: The Elf Bar Plus 12 Prefilled Pod Kit is designed for long-lasting convenience and consistent performance, making it an excellent choice for everyday vaping. Reimagining the classic Elf Bar shape, this device offers a comfortable, handy grip and a transparent pod that allows you to keep a close eye on your e-liquid levels. Powered by a 800mAh built-in battery, the Plus 12 delivers reliable use throughout the day and features a clear LED battery indicator to monitor your power status. The kit utilises an intelligent auto-refill system, pairing a 2ml prefilled pod with an 8ml refill container. Once connected, the reservoir automatically ensures a steady supply of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid to the pod, providing up to 12,000 puffs with minimal maintenance. Equipped with advanced QUAQ mesh coil technology and fixed airflow, the device provides exceptionally smooth vapour and enhanced flavour reproduction from the first inhale to the last. With draw-activated firing, there are no buttons or complex menus to navigate—simply assemble the refill pack, insert it into the device, and inhale to vape. How to Set Up Your Elf Bar Plus 12 Kit Step 1 Remove the sticker and silicone mouthpiece from the 2ml pod. Step 2 Attach the 8ml refill container to the refillable pod and press firmly together to activate the auto-refill system. Step 3 Remove the silicone plug from the base of the assembled pod. Step 4 Insert the assembled refill pack into the device. Step 5 Inhale on the mouthpiece to start vaping. ✅ Ready to vape Elf Bar Plus 12 Kit Flavours • Banana Ice A sweet, mellow Banana flavour with a clean, cooling Menthol finish. • Blue Razz Lemonade A tangy blend of sweet Blue Raspberry and sharp, fizzy Lemonade. • Blueberry A rich, juicy burst of authentic Blueberry flavour in every puff. • Blueberry Sour Raspberry A balanced, tangy twist on sweet Blueberries and sharp Raspberry. • Cherry A juicy, candy-inspired Cherry flavour with deep, bold sweetness. • Cola Classic, refreshing Cola flavour offering sweet soda notes and a familiar fizzy tang. • Grape Bold, juicy Grape with rich fruit character and a deep, satisfying finish. • Kiwi Passion Fruit Guava An exotic tropical trio combining tangy Kiwi, sweet Passion Fruit, and smooth Guava. • Mango Sweet, ripe and tropical Mango flavour delivering a rich and satisfying exotic vape. • Peach Ice Smooth, juicy Peach flavour lifted by a crisp and refreshing icy finish. • Pink Lemonade A sparkling blend of sweet Red Berries and citrus Lemonade with a light, refreshing exhale. • Spearmint A clean, fresh Spearmint flavour with a naturally sweet edge and a cool exhale. • Strawberry Ice Sweet, ripe, sun-ripened Strawberry with a light, cooling Menthol exhale. • Strawberry Raspberry Cherry Ice A trio of bright, juicy berries with a crisp, cool Menthol twist. • Watermelon Fresh, mellow Watermelon flavour with a subtly sweet and lightly cooling finish.
